dry_run.basis: measured per-fold means (point + intervals) of the discovery and H3 records on this machine, and for the closed-form comparators B0 / B3i / B3x -- which have no discovery record at all and had been priced 0.0 s, 1,702 of these folds -- the measured mean of prepare_fold + ComparatorIntervalsRunner.point over the first 10 real selection-half folds of each stem (UNIT_SECONDS). The parallel efficiency 1.96x at 2 workers is measured (discovery: 149.91 h serial in 76.5955 h wall) and the confirmation fit loop now actually uses a 2-process pool, so the wall figure is reachable. Treat +-30 % as the honest band: discovery itself overran its 60 h budget by 28 %. The V6 learned-arm lines assume the section 3.4 FROZEN configurations (the 0.2785 factor is a tuning saving): the tree as it stands re-tunes them, which is why the runner refuses at stage 'v6_frozen_configurations' -- implemented as registered, the V6 block is the 8.5 h costed here; run as the code stands it would be about 30 h, and the plan about 132 h rather than 110 h

run_stages.what: the five gates of confirmation.gate: seal + registered below-footer digest, the registry's 'confirmation' stage and this code, the plan with <= 5 claims, a verified --seed-store, the idempotence lock
decisions/CONFIRMATION_PLAN.md parsed into frozen claims (arm, comparator, design, margin)
the job and fold inventory of the core run and its cost from the measured unit costs (--dry-run)
the store loaded and verified, seeds held in a redacted SeedStore, every written field scrubbed to an opaque index, and the leak scan
the confirmation-half prepare_fold (discovery's assertions, the half switched, the V6 carve-out asserted in both directions) and run_fold
R19 at confirmation over the 5 seeds: the seed-mean cluster bootstrap for items 1, 2, 3 and 5, item 4 at 5 of 5, TOST, BH

building the withheld-seed colourings on the corpus: cell_holdout.v5_batched_folds (max_cells_per_batch = 4) and v5pair_batched_folds per seed, and the V6 design of section 3.4 (support_graph.hide_cells(component_aware=True) on Pr(III) x S and Nd(III) x S together, 13 systems)

the corpus load and the job -> fold dispatch with the wall-clock ledger, in process at --workers 1 and over a ProcessPoolExecutor of at most 2 workers above it (fold-level parallelism inside a job, at most --workers folds in flight; each worker loads and VERIFIES the seed store itself and returns only scrubbed values). --workers was accepted, bounds-checked, logged and then ignored while the plan, the dry run and this line all advertised the 2-worker wall clock; the flag now does what they say

assembling S1(c)'s per-seed per-system direction deltas from the V5-PAIR records (the statistic itself is implemented and tested: confirmation.seed_mean_system_bootstrap / s1c_confirmation), and S1(d) / S1(e) from the prediction frames
assembling S2(a)-(c) from the V6 records (the statistics are implemented and tested: confirmation.s2a_sign_count / s2b_magnitude / coverage_bands)

wiring decisions/confirmation.json, tables/confirmation_*.csv|md and decisions/CONFIRMATION.md to a completed run (the writers themselves are implemented and tested: confirmation.write_decisions / confirmation_tables / confirmation_report)

the arms' own V6 branches inside scripts/g19_run_discovery.py, corrected under POST-HOC addendum 7 item 2. Section 3.4 defines V6 as the V5 state-level rule of section 3.1 and section 7 registers 'V6: V5-style inner cells', which addendum 1 item 1 makes the simultaneous-hiding design; the addendum records that reading and the four sites that branched on g19_run_discovery.v5_family(job) -- ('V5', 'V5P', 'V5PAIR'), which V6 was not -- are fixed: (1) validation_splits and (2) _calibration_splits now send a V6 job to the addendum-1 simultaneous V5 inner design instead of the registered V1 / V2 tuning path; (3) inner_design_record labels that draw as the V5 design and inner_design_signature(job) carries the V5 PRIMARY signature, so the addendum-1 drift check of simultaneous_inner_design runs on the V6 path and the resume digest carries the inner-design signature; (4) ComparatorIntervalsRunner.point gives the B3x / B3i yardsticks of the V6 run interface.InnerCellCalibration -- the V5 cell design -- instead of the V2 METAL-holdout one. v5_family now reads ('V5', 'V5P', 'V5PAIR', 'V6'); the comparator branch reads ('V5', 'V6') and deliberately not v5_family, because V5-P / V5-PAIR comparator-interval jobs exist (the S1(c) yardstick B3x@V5PAIR__primary__batched) and widening that branch would change the S1(c) yardstick intervals, which no addendum registers. The edit is logged in manifests/digest_registry.json, it changes the discovery stage's CODE digest (so no discovery job can be refitted under it, which is correct: discovery is complete), and it validates or invalidates no record written earlier -- no discovery, candidates, ladder, H3 or power job is of design V6 (addendum 2 item 5). V6 still runs ONCE (section 3.4), so no fold of the real corpus is fitted as a rehearsal; the path is exercised end to end on a SYNTHETIC mini-corpus with a fake seed store instead (tests/test_confirmation.py).

POST-HOC addendum 7 item 1's registered S2(c) logSF interval: split conformal on the PAIR residuals of each fold's inner calibration comparable pairs with the section 12 finite-sample quantile (confirmation.pair_calibration_residuals / pair_conformal_quantiles), the quadrature fallback below 20 calibration pairs flagged and counted, and both constructions printed -- with the consequence of the registered calibration population RECORDED beside it (CF.READINGS ['s2c_calibration_population']): the addendum calibrates on 'the comparable pairs', which is any two distinct metal states of a condition group, while the scored pairs are Pr/Nd only, so the interval is biased WIDE and a high-side 80 % FAIL may be that artefact. The composition, the two medians and an EXPLORATORY Pr/Nd-only coverage are recorded; the registered value is unchanged and is the verdict

section 6's 'M2 keeps each outer fold's retained M1 hyperparameters' on THIS run's records: FoldContext.sibling_record / m1_record_locator. Discovery's NeuralRunner.m1_record resolves evaluation/discovery/M1/<design>/s<withheld seed>/<fold>.json, which this run never writes, so every M2 fold raised 'M2 needs M1's per-fold values' -- M2 on V5-primary (claims C1-C3), on V5-PAIR (S1(c)) and on V6 (S2), about 97 of the 110 h plan. The locator reads evaluation/confirmation/records/M1/<design>/i<k>/ and applies the equivalent staleness check on the fields a confirmation record carries (fold_hash, the LIVE code digest, the seed index, the registry stage, a completed point step, the parquet, registry.verify_record), with every message built from the scrubbed label

the section 3.4 'frozen configurations' of the single V6 run. Section 3.4: *'Once only. V6 is not run in Phase C or discovery. It runs once, with the frozen configurations and the withheld seeds (section 15).'* confirmation.enumerate_jobs marks every V6 job ConfJob(tuned=False) and marks the C4 ACT_PERMUTED leg the same way -- and NOTHING READS THAT FLAG: it is set in three places in confirmation.py and read nowhere. So the fit loop hands a V6 job g19_run_discovery.default_runners()['M1'] / ['M2'], the TUNING runners, and the single applied test re-tunes on the V6 folds. MEASURED, not inferred: a V6 M1 fold fitted 9 configurations over 27 inner fits and its record's selected_config came from this run's own inner macro MAE (B8 is unaffected: 'B8 has no tuning'). Two consequences. (1) The V6 leg is not the registered applied test: its configuration is chosen inside the run that scores it, which is the one thing section 7's 'V6 is touched once' exists to prevent -- it is not selection on the OUTER V6 scores, so it is not the same defect as peeking, but it is not what section 3.4 registers either. (2) The cost is understated: UNIT_SECONDS prices the V6 learned arms at 0.2785 x their tuned V5 cost precisely BECAUSE no tuning was expected, so the V6 block is about 30 h serial rather than 8.5 h and the plan about 132 h rather than 110 h. WHY THIS IS NOT FIXED HERE: section 3.4 says 'the frozen configurations' and names no source, and a V6 fold did not exist in discovery, so there is no per-fold retained configuration to carry. Which configuration a V6 fold inherits -- the deployed one of addendum 3 item 2, the per-seed V5-primary selection, the seed-104729 one -- is a REGISTERED CHOICE that no addendum makes. It needs an orchestrator decision and an addendum, exactly as the 'frozen configurations' wording itself does. Until then the runner refuses here rather than producing a V6 number from a configuration this run chose for itself. The machinery already exists and is tested: h3.frozen_runner ('FrozenNeural', 'FrozenB6', ...) refits at a recorded configuration with no re-tuning, and scripts/g19_run_h3.py drives it

the section 11 training transform of claim C4's control leg. confirmation.enumerate_jobs enumerates C4 as B6 with transform 'WITH' and B6 with transform 'ACT_PERMUTED' on the V2 folds, job_spec_of turns that into JobSpec.condition -- and NOTHING IN THIS RUNNER READS JobSpec.condition. There is no call to h3.transformed_frame, to discovery.h3_training_rows or to h3.frozen_runner anywhere in this script or in g19_run_discovery.py: the transform lives in scripts/g19_run_h3.py, which the confirmation loop does not use. MEASURED with call counters over a complete run_fold: all three are called ZERO times.
